activity_summary: You opened a heading, Of Kings, and wrote that it is not a play. The folded sheet has five lines: lists, a banishment, a death, a landing, a crown handed across. You copied the heralds at Coventry onto the sheet and did not speak them. Verona is shut. There is no speech.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the shape, copied without speaking, and stopped before a line anyone could say.

facets.activity: Opened the heading Of Kings and set five lines

topics: the heralds copied and not spoken

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Not a play. A folded sheet.
